about_the_game:
Gather up to 12 friends, family, or rivals for a fast-paced snowball showdown! Pick your penguin team, West or East, and face off to determine the champions of the ice!



SnowDown is a party game played on a shared PC screen, where players use their phones or other internet-connected devices as controllers. Simply pull back on the snowball and release to send it flying to the other side!



Throw snowballs to build up your TURBO meter over time, landing hits on your opponents and their fort for maximum gain. When the time is right, simply activate and pull back!



Don't forget to keep an eye out for presents from above! Targeting these can bring your team a special surprise to turn the tide of the match.



Knock 'em down, get knocked down, get back up again! Try to keep your team's fort standing against the onslaught of snow and the forces of gravity as you both race to the top with increasing speed. One throw can make the difference between victory and defeat!



  • Shared-screen Multiplayer - Host games for up to 12 players using their own devices, no app installation or setup required. Simply visit the website in a browser to join!
  • Physics-based Action - Hone your aim and find the weak points of your opponent's structure. The right hit can bring everything down!
  • Randomized Power-Ups - Keep each round unique with a variety of power-ups to provide maximum snow fort destruction.
  • CPU Players - Computer-controlled players with adjustable difficulties can be added to either team to add balance or a co-operative challenge.

(Requires a broadband internet connection for the PC and player devices. An unstable or poor connection may adversely affect gameplay.)
